decisions: Dispatcher (two_terminal_resistance) operates on the backend-neutral edge list [(u,v,r),...] already shared by the CG/SciPy backends, not on v0.13's adjacency+rfun (a network-layer shape, ARCH-004/Session 07), keeping core/solver pure and backend-independent while reproducing v0.13's dense/sparse crossover exactly.
Dense two-terminal path re-derived from an edge list to build the same grounded conductance matrix and return V[dst]; verified equal to v0.13 network_resistance within 1e-12.

All backends and the dense dispatcher use sorted(nodes, key=str) node ordering (v0.13's CG/SciPy convention), giving deterministic output; float differences vs v0.13's dict-order dense path are ~1e-15, inside V11 tolerances.
Extracted functions given clean public names with provenance recorded in docstrings; behavior, epsilons, and tie-breaks copied verbatim (Session 03 precedent).
BASE-005 marked closed because its Done-when is documentation of a decision + thresholds, fully within this session's owned scope (unlike Session 03's PWR-001, which needed cross-session modules).
